name: pianoize
description: Prepare a song, arrange it for two hands and polish its tsumugi-piano-cover MIDI in Claude Code: from a YouTube link or an audio file, downloads a link's audio, installs tsumugi and tsumugi-piano-cover once, transcribes the song, extracts its melody and generates its piano cover; writes a per-bar two-hand score from tsumugi's transcription alone, for a sung song a full right hand over a pianist's left hand and for an instrumental the band layer by layer, or from the cover and the melody when asked, which the local pianoize CLI builds into MIDI on the song's tempo grid, checks for playability or, for listening, its tune and harmony, and lists the left-hand notes the band doesn't back; and weighs chordotomy's chords, tsumugi's transcription and the cover's notes into one refined timeline, judges the cover's candidate clashes, slips, voice leading and timing, and has the CLI apply the corrections deterministically; and renders an approved arrangement's falling-notes video and thumbnail, and writes its upload's title, description and tags in English and Korean.
